description.p: Vellum is a calibre-inspired ebook library manager. Organize your ebook collection, edit metadata, read EPUB, MOBI, and PDF books, and keep your library tidy.

Vellum supports calibre metadata-source and store plugins, can fetch metadata and covers online from sources such as Google Books and OpenLibrary, and adds shelves, reading statistics, and full-text search across book contents.
Resolve download links from calibre store plugins such as Library Genesis: the browser shim now preserves POST request bodies, so JSON decrypt endpoints are queried correctly.
Fix loading of real calibre plugin archives: metadata-source plugins are now imported as calibre_plugins packages, with the calibre shim extended for the helpers they use.
The Flatpak bundles the Python libraries those plugins import (lxml, six, beautifulsoup4, html5lib, requests), so installed metadata and store plugins are recognized again.
Vellum is now a Flutter/Dart application.
Reader for EPUB, MOBI, and PDF with adjustable font size, highlights, dictionary lookup, themes, table of contents, and automatic position resume.
New shelves, reading statistics, and full-text search across book contents. Calibre metadata and store plugins continue to work through the bundled Python plugin sidecar.
The window title bar follows the app's light or dark theme.
Replace draggable Adw.HeaderBar titlebars with plain GTK headers, so Vellum never sends xdg_toplevel_move and cannot trigger Mutter 50.5's touch-grab NULL dereference.
Force compact/portrait windows into fullscreen and keep them there, preventing the too-small window size that crashes Mutter.
Remove automatic maximize (it can hit Mutter's auto-maximize snapshot crash), add VELLUM_X11=1 for testing Xwayland, and log raw monitor geometry.
Open compact/portrait layouts maximized so the window does not need to be dragged, and add a Maximize Window menu action.
Add VELLUM_DISABLE_TOUCH=1 to swallow touchscreen events and remove the reader swipe gesture, and move the swipe gesture to the bubble phase, to isolate drag-triggered crashes.
Add startup stage markers to crash.log and a VELLUM_MINIMAL=1 window that bypasses the entire library UI, to isolate the portrait-mode instant crash.

Portrait-mode startup hardening: clamp the initial window to the monitor, use a compact header on narrow screens, write uncaught tracebacks/fatal signals to crash.log, and add VELLUM_SAFE_MODE=1 to bypass thumbnail decoding.
Add Inventaire as a high-quality English metadata source, remove Crossref, and restrict all metadata searches to English results.

Add Internet Archive, Library of Congress, and Crossref metadata sources, preview result covers in the Fetch Metadata dialog, and stop overriding GDK_BACKEND so autorotate/output changes use the session's native backend.
Book grid tiles are now exactly 2:3 cover posters (160x240) with the title and author overlaid on the cover instead of extra height below it.

Treat non-URL text pasted into the metadata URL field as a fuzzy search string instead of raising an invalid-character grab error. URL input is validated before any network request. Reader pages are retained for the session instead of being destroyed on back, and the app runs through Xwayland with software Mesa to isolate it from compositor surface/driver crashes.

Fix reader font-size and theme injection for EPUB/XHTML documents without a document.head element, so the +/- buttons change text size. Includes fuzzy metadata search, sorting, and swipe page turning.
Add fuzzy metadata search from a free-form title/author/ISBN string, sort controls for the library and metadata results, and horizontal swipe page turning in the reader.
Defer destruction of the previous page and its WebKit surfaces to an idle callback when the back button is used, so touch-triggered teardown cannot race the compositor.

Replace Adw.NavigationView's automatic back button and touch back gesture with a plain page stack and explicit back buttons. This removes the navigation gesture path that crashed GNOME Shell on Surface Go touchscreens.

Stability hardening for low-memory and Intel-GPU systems: software rendering for GTK and WebKit, GdkPixbuf-only thumbnail generation off the main thread, bounded cover downloads and image decoding, and disk-backed calibre database snapshots. Includes the 0.1.4 universal metadata grabber.

Add a universal metadata grabber: paste any book page URL and extract JSON-LD, OpenGraph, or microdata; results from all sources can be merged into one best match. Cover thumbnails are now generated with GdkPixbuf off the main thread instead of creating GDK textures in a worker, avoiding a compositor-crashing pattern on some drivers.
Fix a crash while reporting calibre import errors, show the first per-book failure in the toast, and keep importing when an optional calibre metadata table is missing or malformed.
Fix importing calibre libraries whose metadata.db is read-only, in WAL mode, or behind a document-portal/FUSE mount. Imports now snapshot the database off the UI thread and stream rows.
Import books from an existing calibre library folder, hide books from the library grid, and no longer seed sample books.
